description: This file defines classes, enums, and functions for managing pairing alerts within a macOS application. It includes UI components, alert handling, and push notification management related to pairing requests.

classes.name: PairingAlertHostWindow
classes.description: A custom NSWindow subclass that can become key and main windows, used as a host window for pairing alerts.

classes.name: PairingAlertState
classes.description: Maintains the state of active pairing alerts including the alert dialog, request ID, and host window.

methods.name: endActiveAlert
methods.description: Ends the currently active alert, optionally using the sheet parent window to end the sheet.

methods.name: requireAlertHostWindow
methods.description: Ensures that an alert host window exists, creating one if necessary, and returns it.

methods.name: configureDefaultPairingAlert
methods.description: Configures an NSAlert with default style, buttons, and destructive action based on macOS version.

methods.name: beginCenteredSheet
methods.description: Positions the alert window centered on the host window's screen and presents it as a sheet.

methods.name: runPairingPushTask
methods.description: Performs push subscription refresh and consumption tasks asynchronously.

methods.name: startPairingPushTask
methods.description: Initiates a background task for handling pairing push notifications.

methods.name: beginPairingAlert
methods.description: Creates and presents a pairing alert as a sheet, executing a completion handler upon response.

methods.name: presentPairingAlert
methods.description: Displays a pairing alert with specified request ID and messages, updating the active alert state.

methods.name: presentPairingAlert<Request>
methods.description: A generic method to present a pairing alert tied to a request of any type, handling response asynchronously.

methods.name: clearActivePairingAlert
methods.description: Clears the current active alert and dismisses the host window.

methods.name: stopPairingPrompter
methods.description: Stops the pairing prompt, cancels tasks, clears queues, and dismisses alert windows.

methods.name: approveRequest
methods.description: Attempts to approve a pairing request by executing a provided action, logs success or failure.

methods.name: rejectRequest
methods.description: Attempts to reject a pairing request by executing a provided action, logs success or failure.
